headlines.title: Inside Ukraine's 'Kill Zone' where soldiers face swarming drones in new age of war
headlines.description: The 'Kill Zone' runs along the 750-mile front between Ukraine and Russia and is about 20 miles wide. It's likely one of the deadliest places on earth right now, as swarms of new high-tech drones act as killing machines. NBC News' Richard Engel talks to Ukrainian soldiers fighting to survive in this new era of warfare.

headlines.title: Father of two and teacher credited for saving lives at deadly school shooting that killed four
headlines.description: Authorities tonight are crediting a father of two who happened to be driving by the school on his lunch break when he heard gun shots, along with a teacher who threw a cell phone and tackled the gunman, for saving lives. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Oregon police say teacher tackled suspected shooter, who previously attended Silver Rail Elementary
headlines.description: A teacher "fought" and "tackled" the suspected shooter by throwing her cell phone at him, according to Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz. The victim, who has been identified as Griffin J. John II, previously attended Silver Rail Elementary. The investigation is still active and underway.

headlines.title: Oregon school shooting victims include 5-year-old whose family is ‘broken and lost’
headlines.description: The victims killed in a special needs classroom at an Oregon elementary school Thursday included a 5-year-old boy whose family said they are “broken and lost” after the shooting and a young teacher working her “dream job.”

headlines.title: The pope goes under the knife, and a new dinosaur species is discovered: The news quiz
headlines.description: An investigation forces the resignation of a U.S. ambassador, a family dog braves the Yellowstone wilderness, and a celebrity gets into a public feud with a New York City shop.

headlines.title: Pope Leo discharged from hospital after lung cancer surgery
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV was discharged from the hospital on Saturday after undergoing surgery for lung cancer, with his surgeon saying he could be fully recovered in about 10 days.

headlines.title: Miley Cyrus Honors Late Godmother Dolly Parton With Emotional Performance
headlines.description: Miley Cyrus performed a passionate rendition of her “Aunt Dolly’s” classic “Jolene” during her performance at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles.

headlines.title: 71-year-old man dies after alligator attack while fishing in Florida, police say
headlines.description: A 71-year-old man died after an alligator attacked him while he was fishing, authorities said on Friday.

headlines.title: ‘The house was toast’: Surf swallows California homes
headlines.description: The worst of El Niño is still months away, but Southern California’s fragile coastline is already being transformed by record-setting king tides and storm surges.

headlines.title: Canada’s Mark Carney makes final appeal against Alberta separation ahead of referendum
headlines.description: EDMONTON, Alberta — Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney made a final appeal to voters considering a path toward independence in his home province of Alberta on Friday, warning that a referendum is a dangerous gamble at a time of growing threats to Canada’s sovereignty.
